promptness_criterion.source_text: P95 warning latency below 100 ms for deterministic checks and below 300 ms for the local contextual model on minimum supported hardware.
promptness_criterion.selection_reason: The 300 ms bound is the slower existing local pre-confirmation product latency bound. Reusing it avoids selecting a new removal-specific number after seeing measurements.
promptness_criterion.rounding: integer milliseconds, duration rounded up before comparison

minimum_supported_real_hardware_profile.memory_note: The cited existing profile does not state a RAM minimum; this record does not invent one.
source_text: Windows 10 or newer. macOS and Linux are not supported and onboarding will exit on them.
target ~250 ms on representative hardware (mid-tier 2020-era Windows 10 laptop, 4-core i5).

benchmark_contract.duration_boundary: from accepted removal start through successor authority for every remaining member and removed-member refusal on every new-message read path
